Pressure

Points are logged every 5 min. Lines break where a node didn't report; nothing is filled in. Pressure is the box's own sensor (BMP388), the average of each 10 minutes; times the box was off stay empty. The pressure unit is the box's too.

Tick Business and give a purpose; Reports › Mileage adds them up at the IRS rate for each trip's date (CSV for your taxes).

Saved spots

On / off

Switched onSwitched offOn forGPS

A point is logged every 30 s while moving (at least 15 m), every 5 min while still, and only with a good fix. Lines are never drawn across a gap: a break means the box was off or had no fix. The layers button on the map switches street, satellite and topo maps and turns each day and each list of spots on or off.

Work orders and routines

Work-order categories

The Category dropdown on work orders and routine jobs.

Routine groups

Each job's due date = last done + interval. Heads-up turns the job orange and auto-generates its work order; Overdue turns it red. Either can count forward from the last-done date or back from the due date.

The box

Ah, from the battery label. The time left comes from how fast the charge is falling; the size adds amp-hours and current.

On the box: hold SELECT 1.5 s to turn the screen off; any turn or press wakes it. The buttons' lights follow the screen's brightness (hold BACK and turn the knob) and glow dim while it sleeps; only the button you used blinks.

Backup and History

Backup

Every record: work orders, routines, assets, money, purchases, calendar, the checklist and its archive. You choose whether to add climate, GPS tracks and attachments; attachments already in an earlier backup are left out unless you ask for them.
